Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner swapped the directors’ death dates—assigning Victor Schertzinger’s 1941-10-26 to Thomas N. Heffron and Heffron’s 1951-05-24 to Schertzinger—leading to the incorrect conclusion that The Love Charm’s director died earlier. The sources shown indicated the opposite (Schertzinger died in 1941; Heffron in 1951).
